propositions.P_NE_NP: P differs from NP (classical, uniform deterministic time).
propositions.AVG_HARD: DistNP is not contained in AvgP in the chosen classical distributional-complexity convention.
propositions.ETH: Exponential Time Hypothesis for bounded-width 3SAT (variable-based subexponential time).
propositions.GAP_ETH: Gap-ETH for the corresponding classical SAT promise.
propositions.THREE_SUM_HYP: No truly subquadratic algorithm for polynomially bounded integer 3SUM.
propositions.APSP_HYP: No truly subcubic algorithm for polynomially bounded integer-weight directed APSP.
propositions.ZWK_HYP: Fine-grained worst-case zero-weight fixed-k clique hardness at exponent k-o(1).
propositions.ZWK_AVG_HYP: Stated average-case fine-grained zero-weight fixed-k clique hardness, for distributions in the construction.
propositions.LWE_HARD: Classical average-case LWE hardness in the parameter regime of a specified scheme.
propositions.ECDLP_HARD: Classical ECDLP hardness for the parameter family under review.

evidence.scope: Fixed-width CNF and uniform resource accounting must match the Lean endpoint; EvalMath PRs #10/#11 audit the seam.
Exact #SAT on bounded-width 3CNF; manuscript and implemented bounds must be distinguished.
Integer 3SUM, polynomially bounded integers; O(n^1.9992) in original announcement.
Integer-weight directed APSP with polynomially bounded weights; O(n^2.9995).
Fixed-k zero-weight k-clique with polynomially bounded integer weights; worst-case speedup.
Universal worst-case speedup also runs on sampled inputs in the same size and weight regime; check a construction's precise distribution and exponents.
Improves deterministic 3SUM bound to n^(1.9945+o(1)) for the specified polynomially bounded integer input setting; follow-up to Alman-VW.
Improves deterministic APSP/min-plus exponent to n^(2.9945+o(1)) in the paper's stated integer-weight setting.
Simplified independent route to truly subquadratic 3SUM and subcubic APSP with weaker exponents; not a proof of cryptographic insecurity.

protocol.evidence_rule: Evidence entries are inert. Scenario assumptions are explicit and optional, never silently promoted from a publication.
protocol.implication_rule: A=>B propagates A=true to B=true and B=false to A=false; the reverse inferences are prohibited.
protocol.route_rule: A failed premise invalidates only that listed conditional route; it is not a cryptanalytic break.
protocol.world_rule: World projections contain P_NE_NP, AVG_HARD, OWF, PKE only; ETH=false imposes no five-world elimination.
